fixture_ids.description: One or more fixture IDs required by this test method. Each ID resolves to an entry in fixtures_summary.

required_state.description: What the test data service must provision. entity + category drive service dispatch; config passes parameters.

entity.description: Domain the test data service owns: CUSTOMER | DRIVER | BOOKING | MERCHANT | PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT | DB_INFRA

category.description: Exact category name from the test data service catalog, e.g. CUSTOMER_WITH_GOPAY, DRIVER_4W_ONLINE. Maps to testDataCategory.testDataCategoryName.

count.description: Number of entities to provision. Maps to testDataCategory.count in the test-data-service request. Omit for DB_INFRA.

config.description: Extra parameters for this category, e.g. wallet_balance_idr, service_area_id. Merged into testDataCategory body.

response_fields_used.description: Canonical field names the test code will call .get() on from the test data service response. Must match the service's documented response schema for this entity+category. Code generator uses this list to emit typed field lookups. Example: ["customerId", "bearerToken", "walletId"]

output.description: Populated by test-data-generator after provisioning. null until TDG runs. Contains the provisioned entity details; code generator reads runtime values from here.
